title: A festa à fantasia
grammar: Contar uma cena: what was happening at the party
goal: Descreva uma cena no passado com várias ações em andamento: was dancing, were laughing.
reading: At June’s party, everyone was wearing a costume.
Na festa da June, todos usavam fantasia.
Tina was wearing a mask and dancing in the living room.
Tina usava uma máscara e dançava na sala.
Ben was putting dessert on the table.
Ben colocava a sobremesa na mesa.
Lou was taking photos of everyone.
Nobody was sitting down because the music was great.
Ninguém estava sentado porque a música estava ótima.
dialogue: What was happening at the party?
O que estava acontecendo na festa?
Who was wearing the big mask?
Tina was. Her costume was amazing!
A Tina. A fantasia dela estava incrível!
What were you doing at ten?
O que você fazia às dez?
I was helping Ben with the dessert.
Eu ajudava o Ben com a sobremesa.
Were the neighbors enjoying it too?
Yes, they were. They were singing in the garden.
pron: Em Tina was dancing, as palavras fortes são Tina e dancing. Was fica fraco e rápido.
gram: Para descrever uma cena em andamento, use was + -ing.
